items.name: sfx_glass_break_1
items.text: A small camera smashes into a glass bottle in someone's hand: one sharp crash of breaking glass with bright tinkling shards falling, close, dry, no music.

items.name: sfx_glass_break_2
items.text: A small camera smashes into a glass bottle in someone's hand: one sharp crash of breaking glass with bright tinkling shards falling, close, dry, no music.

items.name: sfx_cam_floor_1
items.text: A small handheld video camera drops and clatters onto a hard stone floor: one hard plastic and metal impact, a small bounce and a short scrape, close, dry.

items.name: sfx_cam_floor_2
items.text: A small handheld video camera drops and clatters onto a hard stone floor: one hard plastic and metal impact, a small bounce and a short scrape, close, dry.

items.name: sfx_glitch_1
items.text: A broken digital video camera malfunctioning: short electronic glitch stutters and crackling buzz, then a thin dying electronic whine that cuts to silence.

items.name: sfx_glitch_2
items.text: A broken digital video camera malfunctioning: short electronic glitch stutters and crackling buzz, then a thin dying electronic whine that cuts to silence.

items.name: sfx_toss_1
items.text: A small camera thrown hard through the air past the microphone: one quick airy whoosh with a fast spinning flutter, no impact.

items.name: sfx_toss_2
items.text: A small camera thrown hard through the air past the microphone: one quick airy whoosh with a fast spinning flutter, no impact.

items.name: sfx_skid_1
items.text: Leather shoes skidding to a sudden stop on a smooth stone floor: one quick comic scuffing slide.

items.name: sfx_skid_2
items.text: Leather shoes skidding to a sudden stop on a smooth stone floor: one quick comic scuffing slide.

items.name: sfx_hammer_1
items.text: A hammer nailing a wooden plank across a window outdoors: two quick solid hammer blows on wood.

items.name: sfx_hammer_2
items.text: A hammer nailing a wooden plank across a window outdoors: two quick solid hammer blows on wood.

items.name: sfx_paper_tear_1
items.text: One long slow dry tear of thick parchment paper, close.

items.name: sfx_paper_tear_2
items.text: One long slow dry tear of thick parchment paper, close.

items.name: sfx_paper_flap_1
items.text: One dry flap of a folded paper letter snapping open, close, very short.

items.name: sfx_paper_flap_2
items.text: One dry flap of a folded paper letter snapping open, close, very short.

items.name: sfx_paper_crack
items.text: A strip of heavy paper snapped taut in the air: one sharp crisp papery crack, very short.

items.name: sfx_wax_thunk_1
items.text: A wax seal pressed down hard onto a paper letter on a wooden desk: one soft, low, heavy thunk, close, dry.

items.name: sfx_wax_thunk_2
items.text: A wax seal pressed down hard onto a paper letter on a wooden desk: one soft, low, heavy thunk, close, dry.

items.name: sfx_wax_tick
items.text: A small seal tapped onto soft wax: one tiny dry tick, close, very short.

items.name: sfx_wax_tock
items.text: A knuckle rapped twice on hard set wax: a soft tock tock, close.

items.name: sfx_quill_dabs
items.text: Three quick dabs of a quill pen on paper, each a short scratchy tap, rising.

items.name: sfx_quill_stroke
items.text: One quick hard stroke of a quill pen across paper: a short scratch.

items.name: sfx_paper_fold
items.text: A paper letter folded with two fast crisp creases, close.

items.name: sfx_unroll
items.text: An old parchment scroll unrolled quickly on a table with a dry crackle, close.

items.name: sfx_hug
items.text: Two people hug tightly: a soft rustle of heavy velvet and wool clothes, close and gentle.

items.name: amb_feast
items.text: A Renaissance masked ball in a big stone hall: lively crowd chatter and laughter, cups clinking, shuffling dance steps on stone, no music, steady.
